잠언-12-1.title: 잠언 12장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-1.exegesis: 24-31. The scope of the whole is a comment on Pr 11:23 . Thus liberality, by God's blessing, secures increase, while penuriousness, instead of expected gain, procures poverty.
잠언-12-1.theologicalNote: 24-31. The scope of the whole is a comment on Pr 11:23 . Thus liberality, by God's blessing, secures increase, while penuriousness, instead of expected gain, procures poverty.

잠언-12-2.title: 잠언 12장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 12 Pr 12:1-28 . 1. loveth knowledge-- as the fruit of instruction or training ( Pr 1:2 ). hateth reproof-- ( Pr 10:17 ). brutish-- stupid, regardless of his own welfare ( Psa 49:10 ; 73:22 ).
잠언-12-2.theologicalNote: CHAPTER 12 Pr 12:1-28 . 1. loveth knowledge-- as the fruit of instruction or training ( Pr 1:2 ). hateth reproof-- ( Pr 10:17 ). brutish-- stupid, regardless of his own welfare ( Psa 49:10 ; 73:22 ).

잠언-12-3.exegesis: CHAPTER 12 Pr 12:1-28 . 1. loveth knowledge-- as the fruit of instruction or training ( Pr 1:2 ). hateth reproof-- ( Pr 10:17 ). brutish-- stupid, regardless of his own welfare ( Psa 49:10 ; 73:22 ).

잠언-12-4.title: 잠언 12장 4절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-4.exegesis: 3. Wickedness cannot give permanent prosperity. root ... not be moved-- firm as a flourishing tree--( Psa 1:3 ; 15:5 ; Jr 17:8 ).
잠언-12-4.theologicalNote: 3. Wickedness cannot give permanent prosperity. root ... not be moved-- firm as a flourishing tree--( Psa 1:3 ; 15:5 ; Jr 17:8 ).

잠언-12-5.title: 잠언 12장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-5.exegesis: 4. A virtuous woman-- in the wide sense of well-disposed to all moral duties ( Pr 31:10 ). maketh ashamed-- that is, by misconduct. rottenness-- an incurable evil.
잠언-12-5.theologicalNote: 4. A virtuous woman-- in the wide sense of well-disposed to all moral duties ( Pr 31:10 ). maketh ashamed-- that is, by misconduct. rottenness-- an incurable evil.

잠언-12-6.title: 잠언 12장 6절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-6.exegesis: 5. thoughts-- or, "purposes." are right-- literally, "are judgment," that is, true decisions. counsels-- (Compare Pr 11:14 ). deceit-- contrary to truth and honesty.
잠언-12-6.theologicalNote: 5. thoughts-- or, "purposes." are right-- literally, "are judgment," that is, true decisions. counsels-- (Compare Pr 11:14 ). deceit-- contrary to truth and honesty.

잠언-12-7.title: 잠언 12장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-7.exegesis: 6. The words-- or, "expressed designs" of the wicked are for evil purposes. the mouth-- or, "words" of the righteous delivering instead of ensnaring men.
잠언-12-7.theologicalNote: 6. The words-- or, "expressed designs" of the wicked are for evil purposes. the mouth-- or, "words" of the righteous delivering instead of ensnaring men.

잠언-12-8.title: 잠언 12장 8절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-8.exegesis: 7. Such conduct brings a proper return, by the destruction of the wicked and well-being of the righteous and his family.
잠언-12-8.theologicalNote: 7. Such conduct brings a proper return, by the destruction of the wicked and well-being of the righteous and his family.

잠언-12-9.title: 잠언 12장 9절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-9.exegesis: 8. despised-- as opposed to commended ( Pr 11:12 ). perverse heart-- or, "wicked principles," as opposed to one of wisdom.
잠언-12-9.theologicalNote: 8. despised-- as opposed to commended ( Pr 11:12 ). perverse heart-- or, "wicked principles," as opposed to one of wisdom.

잠언-12-10.title: 잠언 12장 10절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-10.exegesis: 9. despised-- held in little repute, obscure ( 1Sa 18:23 ; Is 3:5 ). hath a servant-- implying some means of honest living. honoureth himself-- is self-conceited.
잠언-12-10.theologicalNote: 9. despised-- held in little repute, obscure ( 1Sa 18:23 ; Is 3:5 ). hath a servant-- implying some means of honest living. honoureth himself-- is self-conceited.

잠언-12-11.title: 잠언 12장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-11.exegesis: 10. regardeth-- literally, "knoweth" ( Psa 1:6 ). mercies ... cruel-- as acts of compassion ungraciously rendered to the needy. The righteous more regards a beast than the wicked a man.
잠언-12-11.theologicalNote: 10. regardeth-- literally, "knoweth" ( Psa 1:6 ). mercies ... cruel-- as acts of compassion ungraciously rendered to the needy. The righteous more regards a beast than the wicked a man.

잠언-12-12.title: 잠언 12장 12절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-12.exegesis: 11. The idler's fate is the result of indolence and want of principle ( Pr 6:32 ; 7:7 ).
잠언-12-12.theologicalNote: 11. The idler's fate is the result of indolence and want of principle ( Pr 6:32 ; 7:7 ).

잠언-12-13.title: 잠언 12장 13절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-13.exegesis: 12. the wicked ... evil-- They love the crafty arts of deception. the root ... fruit-- their own resources supply them; or, it may be rendered: "He (God) giveth, or, sets ( Eze 17:22 ) the root of the righteous," and hence it is firm: or, the verb is impersonal; "As to the root ... it is firm" ( Pr 17:19 ).
잠언-12-13.theologicalNote: 12. the wicked ... evil-- They love the crafty arts of deception. the root ... fruit-- their own resources supply them; or, it may be rendered: "He (God) giveth, or, sets ( Eze 17:22 ) the root of the righteous," and hence it is firm: or, the verb is impersonal; "As to the root ... it is firm" ( Pr 17:19 ).

잠언-12-14.title: 잠언 12장 14절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-14.exegesis: 13-14. The wicked is snared, &c.-- The sentiment expanded. While the wicked, such as liars, flatterers, &c., fall by their own words, the righteous are unhurt. Their good conduct makes friends, and God rewards them.
잠언-12-14.theologicalNote: 13-14. The wicked is snared, &c.-- The sentiment expanded. While the wicked, such as liars, flatterers, &c., fall by their own words, the righteous are unhurt. Their good conduct makes friends, and God rewards them.

잠언-12-15.title: 잠언 12장 15절 역사문법적 주해

잠언-12-15.theologicalNote: 13-14. The wicked is snared, &c.-- The sentiment expanded. While the wicked, such as liars, flatterers, &c., fall by their own words, the righteous are unhurt. Their good conduct makes friends, and God rewards them.

잠언-12-16.title: 잠언 12장 16절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-16.exegesis: 15. The way ... eyes-- The fool is self-conceited (compare Pr 12:1 ; 1:32; 10:17; Jas 3:17 ).
잠언-12-16.theologicalNote: 15. The way ... eyes-- The fool is self-conceited (compare Pr 12:1 ; 1:32; 10:17; Jas 3:17 ).

잠언-12-17.title: 잠언 12장 17절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-17.exegesis: 16. prudent ... shame-- He is slow to denounce his insulters ( Jas 1:19 ).
잠언-12-17.theologicalNote: 16. prudent ... shame-- He is slow to denounce his insulters ( Jas 1:19 ).

잠언-12-18.title: 잠언 12장 18절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-18.exegesis: 16. prudent ... shame-- He is slow to denounce his insulters ( Jas 1:19 ).
잠언-12-18.theologicalNote: 16. prudent ... shame-- He is slow to denounce his insulters ( Jas 1:19 ).

잠언-12-19.title: 잠언 12장 19절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-19.exegesis: 18. speaketh-- literally, "speaketh hastily," or indiscreetly ( Psa 106:33 ), as an angry man retorts harsh and provoking invectives. tongue ... health-- by soothing and gentle language.
잠언-12-19.theologicalNote: 18. speaketh-- literally, "speaketh hastily," or indiscreetly ( Psa 106:33 ), as an angry man retorts harsh and provoking invectives. tongue ... health-- by soothing and gentle language.

잠언-12-20.title: 잠언 12장 20절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-20.exegesis: 19. Words of truth are consistent, and stand all tests, while lies are soon discovered and exposed.
잠언-12-20.theologicalNote: 19. Words of truth are consistent, and stand all tests, while lies are soon discovered and exposed.

잠언-12-21.title: 잠언 12장 21절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-21.exegesis: 20. that imagine-- or, "plan" ( Pr 3:29 ). They design a deceitful course, to which, with all its evils and dangers to others and themselves, the happiness of peace-makers is opposed (compare Mt 5:9 ; Ro 12:18 ).
잠언-12-21.theologicalNote: 20. that imagine-- or, "plan" ( Pr 3:29 ). They design a deceitful course, to which, with all its evils and dangers to others and themselves, the happiness of peace-makers is opposed (compare Mt 5:9 ; Ro 12:18 ).

잠언-12-22.title: 잠언 12장 22절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-22.exegesis: 21. no evil-- (as in Psa 91:10 ), under God's wise limitations ( Ro 8:28 ). mischief-- as penal evil.
잠언-12-22.theologicalNote: 21. no evil-- (as in Psa 91:10 ), under God's wise limitations ( Ro 8:28 ). mischief-- as penal evil.

잠언-12-23.title: 잠언 12장 23절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-23.exegesis: 22. deal truly-- or, "faithfully," that is, according to promises (compare Joh 3:21 ).
잠언-12-23.theologicalNote: 22. deal truly-- or, "faithfully," that is, according to promises (compare Joh 3:21 ).

잠언-12-24.title: 잠언 12장 24절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-24.exegesis: 23. concealeth-- by his modesty ( Pr 10:14 ; 11:13 ). heart ... proclaimeth-- as his lips speak his thoughts (compare Ec 10:3 ).
잠언-12-24.theologicalNote: 23. concealeth-- by his modesty ( Pr 10:14 ; 11:13 ). heart ... proclaimeth-- as his lips speak his thoughts (compare Ec 10:3 ).

잠언-12-25.title: 잠언 12장 25절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-25.exegesis: 24. slothful-- (Compare Margin), so called because he fails to meet his promises. under tribute-- not denoting legal taxes, but the obligation of dependence.
잠언-12-25.theologicalNote: 24. slothful-- (Compare Margin), so called because he fails to meet his promises. under tribute-- not denoting legal taxes, but the obligation of dependence.

잠언-12-26.title: 잠언 12장 26절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-26.exegesis: 25. a good word-- one of comfort.
잠언-12-26.theologicalNote: 25. a good word-- one of comfort.

잠언-12-27.title: 잠언 12장 27절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-27.exegesis: 26. more excellent-- (Compare Margin); or, "more successful," while the wicked fail; or, we may read it: "The righteous guides his friend, but," &c., that is, The ability of the righteous to aid others is contrasted with the ruin to which the way of the wicked leads themselves.
잠언-12-27.theologicalNote: 26. more excellent-- (Compare Margin); or, "more successful," while the wicked fail; or, we may read it: "The righteous guides his friend, but," &c., that is, The ability of the righteous to aid others is contrasted with the ruin to which the way of the wicked leads themselves.

잠언-12-28.title: 잠언 12장 28절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-12-28.exegesis: 27. (Compare Pr 12:24 ). took in hunting-- or, "his venison." He does not improve his advantages. the substance ... precious-- or, "the wealth of a man of honor is being diligent," or "diligence." precious-- literally, "honor" ( Ec 10:1 ).
잠언-12-28.theologicalNote: 27. (Compare Pr 12:24 ). took in hunting-- or, "his venison." He does not improve his advantages. the substance ... precious-- or, "the wealth of a man of honor is being diligent," or "diligence." precious-- literally, "honor" ( Ec 10:1 ).
